'''February 2001 New York City tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG decipher day held in Neutral Ground, New York City, New York on 10 February 2001. [[Brian Terwilliger]] won it. It is known from Mike Gemme's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1717">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-12-2-10-nyc-the-search-for-foiled-sheetsd1717/ 2-10-nyc-the-search-for-foiled-sheets], DeckTech (michael "Deck" Gemme, 12 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-12-2-10-nyc-the-search-for-foiled-sheetsd1717/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 10 February 2001
* '''Site:''' Neutral Ground, New York City, New York
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Brian Terwilliger]]
